attempts.summary: Created appworker account on node1 and configured PAM limits (8192 open files, 256 processes) for its login sessions via /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf; verified enforcement with a login shell. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id/uptime, rebooted node1 via systemd-run, confirmed boot_id changed after reconnecting, and re-verified the account/limits config and enforcement post-restart.
